name: EPIC 201583545
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 16.5 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201583545 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.502307 (16th-84th percentiles 15.826289-17.4106), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,568 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.92 solar masses and 16.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,476 K at its surface.
